aboutMe.title: About Me
content: I am a passionate Machine Learning Engineer with experience in developing intelligent systems using Large Language Models (LLMs), Natural Language Processing, and Computer Vision with OpenCV. I specialize in designing data-driven, scalable AI solutions that address real-world challenges with efficiency, reliability, and precision.

I build responsive, user-centric full web applications using modern frameworks such as React and Angular, delivering high-performance front-end interfaces and robust back-end integrations that ensure seamless user experiences across devices.

I am currently pursuing a Bachelor of Engineering in Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Velammal Engineering College, Chennai (2023 – 2027). My academic journey has strengthened my foundation in machine learning, AI fundamentals, and data-driven problem solving.

I am actively growing in the New-Generation AI domain, continuously enhancing my technical expertise and staying updated with modern AI and software development practices. My long-term goal is to build scalable and impactful systems that combine strong engineering principles with advanced machine learning technologies.
